messages:
jen_support: FYI customer (acme-inc) opened a billing escalation — invoice shows ~3.2M tokens billed for May 28-29 but their onprem dashboard aggregates ~2.1M. This is a Private/VPC deployment in eu-west-1. They say nothing changed on our side.

matt_infra: thanks. can you paste invoice id + agent version? first guess is agent replay / buffer flush + clock skew. pinging @anya_sre for infra side.

jen_support: Invoice INV-ACME-20250529-12, meter-agent v2.14 (on-prem package). Customer reported host reboot and NTP reconfiguration around 2025-05-29T03:10Z. I grabbed the agent logs — see below.

anya_sre: if the local clock jumped forward when buffered events were flushed, sequence acking vs audit log can get out of sync and cause double-apply in the ledger. need audit/collector logs to correlate.

jen_support: log snippet from /var/log/meter-agent.log (2025-05-29):
```
2025-05-29T03:09:50Z INFO  meter-agent v2.14 startup seq=384229
2025-05-29T03:10:03Z WARN  clock: NTP step performed, offset +36.120s
2025-05-29T03:10:04Z INFO  buffering: resumed, buffered_events=1423
2025-05-29T03:10:04Z INFO  flush: sending batch id=0x7f3a, events=1423
2025-05-29T03:10:04Z ERROR uploader: transient 500, retrying
2025-05-29T03:10:06Z INFO  uploader: batch sent, ack received ack_seq=385652
```

meter-bot: INFO  projector-received: event_batch id=0x7f3a size=1423 replayed=true

matt_infra: that "clock: NTP step" + "replayed=true" looks suspicious. if the projector or ledger writer accepts replayed events as new (no idempotency), ledger count could include them twice. can we get central collector audit for seq range 384k..386k?

sara_billing: ledger is the source of truth for invoices. invoices are generated from the projector's committed ledger. if duplicate writes landed in ledger because of an older projector bug, invoice would reflect that even if dashboard dedupe hides it.

tariq_customer: confirming from our side: host reboot at 03:09, we reinstalled chrony, then system time jumped ~36s forward and agent restarted. Dashboard showed a short burst but our internal UI only shows the baseline 2.1M — we rely on agent-side counters which look normal.

anya_sre: probable path: agent buffered events during offline window, host time step caused events to be marked replayed; projector v1.8 had a known edge case where replayed=true with clock offsets >30s bypassed dedupe. older projectors wrote duplicates to the ledger. there's a patch in projector v1.9.

jen_support: I pulled the central audit (collector) for the window; it contains duplicate event_ids with different timestamps. Example lines from audit export:
```
{"event_id":"e-0a7c","seq":385642,"token_count":120,"replayed":false,"ts":"2025-05-29T02:55:12Z"}
{"event_id":"e-0a7c","seq":385651,"token_count":120,"replayed":true,"ts":"2025-05-29T03:10:05Z"}
```

matt_infra: yep, duplicate event_id present. projector bug INF-7024. workaround: run ledger dedupe job for this customer and timeframe; that will mark duplicates as tombstones and regenerate invoice rollup. I've opened internal ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7024 (eng-infra assigned)

sara_billing: once dedupe job completes, we'll recalc tokens and issue credit memo. need exact token delta. matt, can you run reconciliation and post token diff? use:

```
/opt/redwood/bin/meter-reconcile --customer acme-inc --from 2025-05-28T22:00:00Z --to 2025-05-29T06:00:00Z --output /tmp/acme-reconcile.json
```

anya_sre: mitigation: recommend customers on older projector versions to upgrade to projector v1.9+ and meter-agent to v2.15 which carries an idempotency header and stricter replay handling. KB note: PRIVATE DEPLOYMENT: clockstep/ntp fixes and agent v2.15 rollout.

jen_support: current action items I tracked:
- collect full /var/log/meter-agent.log (jen) — done, attached to ticket
- run meter-reconcile and produce token diff (matt) — in progress
- run ledger-dedupe job for invoice window (eng-infra) — queued INF-7024
- issue provisional credit (sara) — hold until reconcile result

matt_infra: running reconcile now, ETA ~30m. if ledger-dedupe is needed we should schedule off-peak and notify customer.

sara_billing: please also export the invoice generation logs and projection run id so we can tie the invoice to a projector commit.

jen_support: will loop in @tariq_customer with ETA once reconcile completes. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

anya_sre: long term: add monitoring alert for large flush bursts + clockstep events on Private installs. create playbook entry for dedupe/credit flow.

jen_support: agreed. closing thread when reconcile + dedupe done and customer notified.
